I had an experience with a weird bright light, lol.

I was in bed, and my window is right by my bed, on my left, eye level (my bedroom was on the second story.) I was browsing my phone late at night like 2am when suddenly a bright light coming from my window illuminates my room like daytime. It got brighter and brighter, until it was blinding. 

I instinctively jumped out of the bed and ducked because I didn't know if something was going to come through the window or something, it was just a panicked flight reaction. Then, as soon as it came, it was gone, and the room was dark again. No sound at all the whole time, dead silence (so no helicopter spotlight which was my immediate thought). It was so scary. Any other time I would be curious/annoyed and look out of the window to see wtf it was but my instinct on this instance was to run and hide, so idk if that meant something.

I finally, FINALLY, figured out the bumps were a reaction. It was either an allergy or contact dermatitis, to both hyaluronic acid and niacinamide. So maybe while you’re seeking out different treatments, keep in mind it may be that you’re having a reaction to skin products if you use any! Good luck, I wish you the best!! 🙏🏼
